contracts.normative_equation_or_contract:
`SC-CCI-CL-C-JOINT-ROOT` is accepted as conditional mathematics. Under the
declared homogeneous quartic binding, only C is independent physical state;
f, J and H are jointly reconstructed quantities. On each actual source/target
graph, for C in [0,4]^V and ||f||_infinity <= 1/32, the map

$$
H_{ij}(f)=\delta_{ij}+\frac{O_{ij}}8 f_i f_j,\quad
j_0=-\frac1{1024}B^T\left(\frac1{64}BHB^TC-[(C-2)^3-(C-2)]\right),
$$

$$
y=(\tfrac34I+HB^TB)^{-1}j_0,\quad J=j_0+\tfrac14y,\quad
f=F(C,f)=\tfrac12H^{-1}y
$$

is a strict self-map and contraction in f. Its exact rational image and
contraction bounds are bound by the retained source/target root-domain records.
Thus there is one selected joint root inside the declared ball, not global
uniqueness of every possible root. B is outward incidence and O_ij counts shared
edge endpoints. The root supplies both generated geometry and consumed current.
An OS predictor/corrector or a current-only capture cannot substitute for it.

The selected parameters are c0=2, a=mu=1, eta_C=1/1024, duration=32,
kappa_Phi_C=1/64, tau_C=1, chi_C=zeta_C=kappa_H=1/2, kappa_M_C=0,
unit measures/weights/reference Hodges and autonomous zero context. This
extends the existing quartic scientific binding to one proved C_CI subject;
it neither changes existing zero-site identities nor registers a native evaluator.

`SC-CCI-CL-C-FULL-TRAP` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the full map
T_CI(C)=C-32BJ(C,H(f(C))). Its derivative includes the implicit response

$$
D_Cf=(I-F_f)^{-1}F_C,\qquad
DT_{\rm CI}=I-32B\left(J_C+J_f(I-F_f)^{-1}F_C\right).
$$

Use the retained exact charge-21 center and metric ball K of radius 2^-20,
with P=(A0+11^T/15)^-1 and
A0=B[I+(3I/4+B^TB)^-1/4]B^T. K has fourteen independent relative dimensions.
The fresh whole-box CI derivative and center evaluation certify q_CI<0.997296
and strict image margin >2.5789e-9. Complete domains {p,private} and
{satellite2,n2,n8} hold uniformly in both chiral charts, including all
unqualified routing terminals. Inner-root convergence is not physical stability.

This reuses the exact metric/domain while proving the actual CI map. It does
not reuse OS trajectory entry, assert faster CI convergence or establish
arbitrary-graph/parameter stability. Proof calculations consume fresh certified
root enclosures. Overlap with saved f/H/J intervals establishes consistency
only; it does not independently certify those saved enclosures.

`SC-CCI-CL-C-COMPLETION` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the bound
source/event/target construction. Apply an actual CI ordinary beat to the exact
source prestate, reconstruct its fresh whole joint root and qualified parent,
then apply literal D11 expansion with shares (1/64,31/32,1/64), zero core and
unchanged exterior. The target has fifteen vertices, sixteen edges and exact
charge 21. Allocation alone earns no gain. Current reaches K at the first
certified step 849, then two positive duration-32 beats complete one new stable
satellite child at step 851 with local gain one. The independently executed
reset comparison enters at 817 and ends at 819, earning no live gain.

The approach and window enclose exact equations at fixed 8192-bit Arb; the
trapping proof uses fixed 512-bit Arb. Compact retained coordinates are outward
112-bit enclosures for inspection, not a rounded trajectory or exact replay
checkpoint. Entry counts are sufficient certified times, not earliest
mathematical entry. The `first_spatial_gain` field records first observation of
the final complete roster, not completion. Two charts do not count two births.

The independent bounded review checked all 1,670 retained states, 3,340 chart
classifications and eight distinct joint-root subjects. It did not independently
regenerate the full interval implicit Jacobian or replay the long campaign;
the repository's executions remain separate evidence. Acceptance preserves
these limits and the conditional claim class.
